info.name: nginx DNS Resolver Off-by-One Heap Write
author: pdteam
info.description: nginx resolver is vulnerable to a 1-byte memory overwrite that can lead to worker process crash or potential remote code execution when resolving an attacker-controlled DNS response.

info.name: Spring Cloud Gateway Actuator API - SpEL Code Injection
author: pdteam
info.description: Spring Cloud Gateway Actuator Gateway API endpoint accepts a malicious Spring Expression Language (SpEL) payload in a crafted route definition, leading to remote code execution.

info.name: Werkzeug HTTP Request Smuggling
author: pdteam
info.description: An HTTP request parsing ambiguity in werkzeug allows request smuggling when chunked and content-length framing are both present.

info.name: Jenkins CLI Arbitrary File Read
author: pdteam
info.description: Jenkins CLI command parser (args4j) allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the controller filesystem via the @ character file-expansion feature.

info.name: Atlassian Confluence Server - Unauthenticated OGNL Injection RCE
author: pdteam
info.description: Confluence Server and Data Center are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution via OGNL expression injection.
